components.name: Chart/Sankey
components.description: Flow of a quantity between stages (income → spending → categories, traffic sources → pages). Node = 12 px bar in a categorical colour; link = source colour at 28%. Max 3 columns and 12 nodes; group small flows into "Other". Mobile: replaced by a stacked bar or list (see 4.23 doc). React: <SankeyChart nodes links />
